role: additive execution-feasibility veto; it cannot amend, rerun, or rescue the preregistered primary hypothesis

position_accounting.exit_time: 60 seconds after the order decision, including the 100ms latency decision when applicable
position_accounting.exit_price: first locally available executable best bid for long or best ask for short, maximum five-second gap
position_accounting.partial_remainder: cancel at the preregistered three-second timeout; retain and close the filled quantity
position_accounting.contribution_basis: fill_fraction multiplied by net return, so every eligible signal consumes one equal submitted-notional opportunity

interpretation: The primary report ignores partial fills. This fixed auxiliary replay charges every estimated positive fill and may only veto promotion. PASS remains non-promotional and still does not establish exchange acknowledgement or live fill quality.
